answer: Require every agent identity to rent a non-clonable anchor: a bond escrowed against a hardware root-of-trust plus metered compute the host must actually burn. A second puppet costs the same as the first, so a sybil farm pays full price per fake peer instead of splitting one stake across a thousand shells. Honest agents reclaim the bond on exit. It is like demanding fresh shale for every brick: no counterfeit cliff can be built from a single shard of ocean driftwood, and fabricated timber rots under audit until the swarm collapses.
